insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options: 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L, 7L, 10L, 15L, 20L, 25L, 50L, 75L, 1Cr, 2Cr, 3Cr, 4Cr, 5Cr, 6Cr (plus Super Reload, Super Credit, optional Cancer Booster etc. as applicable)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Room Rent: Actuals up to Sum Insured
great.explanation: Room rent is covered at actual costs up to the sum insured without any daily limit or room category cap. This means you can choose any room type without worrying about fixed daily limits.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 90 days immediately prior to the date of such Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Medical expenses before hospitalization are covered for up to 90 days for the same condition. This is better than the usual 60-day coverage, giving you more financial protection.

great.name: Consumables
great.quote: Non-payable items will be covered (all 4 lists of Annexure I)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (SAVR) / Section C.4 Claim Protect (Non-Medical Expense Waiver)
great.explanation: Non-medical consumables like gloves, masks, and kits are covered when the Claim Protect benefit is active. This reduces your out-of-pocket expenses for such items during hospitalization.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: We shall provide for a reload amounting to the Base Sum Insured (“Super Reload”), unlimited times during the Policy Year
great.explanation: If your sum insured is exhausted, the policy reloads the base sum insured unlimited times within the policy year. This ensures you have extra coverage for multiple claims in the same year.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: Super Credit (Increases Irrespective of Claim) ... An additional limit under the current Policy Year (“Super Credit”) will be applied / increased by a fixed percentage of the Base Sum Insured of immediately preceding Policy Year irrespective of any claims in previous Policy Year
great.reference: Section C.11 Super Credit / Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (SAVR)
great.explanation: Your sum insured can increase at renewal even if you made claims, unlike typical no-claim bonuses that reset. This means your coverage grows over time regardless of claims.

great.name: Modern Treatments
great.quote: Expenses incurred... arising out of any of the below mentioned Indicative list of Modern Procedures / Treatments... Robotic Surgeries... Stereotactic Radio Surgeries... Stem Cell Therapy: Hematopoietic Stem Cells for Bone Marrow Transplant...
great.explanation: The policy covers many modern medical procedures and treatments during hospitalization. This ensures access to advanced healthcare without separate limits.

great.name: Bariatric Surgery
great.quote: Obesity Treatment: Medical Expenses... arising out of Hospitalization for a Bariatric Surgery during the Policy Period subject to the conditions... Section D.1.6
great.explanation: Bariatric surgery is covered if you meet specified medical criteria like BMI and comorbidities. This helps those needing weight-loss surgery get insured treatment.

great.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Period on Domiciliary Hospitalization...
great.explanation: Treatment at home that would otherwise require hospitalization is covered, subject to conditions like minimum 3 days. This provides flexibility for home-based care.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Pre Existing Disease (PED) Waiting Period: 3 years
good.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (SAVR) - Waiting Period (Inbuilt Cover)
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from policy start. This is a standard waiting period in the market.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries / treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...
good.reference: Section D.1.2 Specified disease / procedure Waiting Period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: Certain specified illnesses and procedures are excluded for 24 months from policy start. This is a common industry standard.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: 30-day Waiting Period (Code-Excl03)... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents which are covered immediately. This is a typical initial waiting period.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 180 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital.
good.explanation: Medical expenses after discharge are covered for up to 180 days for the same condition. This is at the higher end of standard post-hospitalization coverage.

bad.name: No-claim Bonus
bad.quote: If the feature from the table above is not found in the document, assume it is NOT covered and flag as BAD.
bad.reference: NCB not expressly defined as NCB/Cumulative Bonus in the provided policy wording excerpts; Super Credit is a separate mechanism
bad.explanation: The policy does not explicitly provide a standard no-claim bonus; instead it offers a Super Credit which is different. Lack of a classic NCB may reduce rewards for claim-free years.

bad.name: Home Health Care
bad.quote: This Benefit requires pre-authorisation and is not available on reimbursement basis.
bad.explanation: Home health care benefits are only available via cashless pre-authorization and not on reimbursement. This limits flexibility if you prefer to pay first and claim later.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount... If the Insured Person takes treatment... other than those listed as “Preferred Provider Network”, then... shall bear a Co-Payment of 10% on each and every claim
bad.reference: Section C.15.5 Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount
bad.explanation: The base policy does not clearly state any mandatory co-pay; only an optional discount plan mentions 10% co-pay outside network. Confirm from the Policy Schedule if any co-pay applies by default.
